title: Seamless tiles for rooms (floors, walls, fabric)

comfyui.note: Uses only built-in ComfyUI nodes (plus the custom node listed, if any). Update ComfyUI if a node shows red.

inputs.default: top-down flat texture of old oak floor planks, seamless, even lighting, no shadows, no perspective, high detail

settings: 1024x1024, 28 steps, CFG 6; seam band repainted at denoise 0.75.
forWhat: Square textures that repeat with no visible seam: wood floor, brick, carpet, tiles, fabric.
output: 1024x1024 PNG that tiles in both directions.
vtp: Use it in your room's material in Blender (or the room creation package). 1024 px fits VTube Pro's texture budget.
ask: Set up the VTube Pro seamless tile workflow in ComfyUI
steps: Say the material in "Your prompt" (keep "flat, even lighting").
Press Run. The workflow swaps the halves and repaints the seams for you.
tips: Baked shadows repeat badly: ask for flat, even light.
Check it: put four copies side by side in any editor.
licenceSummary: Commercial use OK by default: CreativeML Open RAIL++-M.
